We analyzed 427,536 real interactions before building custovox.ai

custovox.ai is not built on assumptions. Before analyzing your customer data, we spent years analyzing real corpora — customer reviews, medical consultations, corporate communications — to validate the models that power the platform.

427,536interactions analyzed in foundational research
4independent research studies across 4 domains
5NLP methods validated on real-world data
🛍️

Consumer electronics reviews — how people really experience technology

Corpus49,985 customer reviews · Semantic clustering (SBERT + k-means)

41.4% of customer verbatims are experiential — not functional. Customers don't describe features. They describe their life with the product. Only 36.6% focus on technical performance.

Applied in TextIQ — emotion and theme detection
🏥

Medical consultations — what predicts relational quality in text

Corpus377,273 text consultations · DistilRoBERTa + BART-MNLI

Affective dispersion (the co-activation of multiple emotions in a single message) predicts relational response quality better than a single dominant emotion. β = 0.163 vs β = 0.083. This principle structures PredictIQ's multi-signal churn scoring.

Applied in PredictIQ — multi-signal churn scoring
📱

Voice assistant reviews — 4 dimensions of linguistic understanding

Corpus278 verified reviews · LDA topic modelling

Customer perception operates across 4 linguistic dimensions: lexical-semantic, contextual, situational and pragmatic. A 4.1/5 average score can hide deep frustration at the pragmatic level — commercial intrusion, broken implicit promises.

Applied in TextIQ — 4-level linguistic analysis
🎤

Corporate speeches — how technology language evolves over time

Corpus13 conferences · 28h 49min of transcribed content · Word2Vec + SBERT + UMAP + HDBSCAN

The word 'intelligence' grew +480% between 2016 and 2025 in technology corporate discourse. 'Device' fell -65%. Companies no longer describe technology — they speak through it. Metaphors shifted from competition to living organisms and collaboration.

Applied in VoiceIQ — longitudinal trend detection

What this research means for your customer data

Most sentiment analysis tools are trained on generic corpora. custovox.ai models are grounded in peer-reviewed research on real customer interactions — not benchmarks, not synthetic data.

The result: analyses that capture what customers actually mean, not just what they literally say.
